observation.what: live VM root disk below 85% after prune-db-backups apply, and the number of <db>.bak-* files bounded (<= the newest 2 + those under 7 days) on the next disk-usage-report

what: [health] Live VM root disk 96% (45 G, 2.4 G free; status-check #18736 07:3xZ). /data/bot-data is a directory on the same root disk. The journal is 2.09 GB (db_info), and ~10 Tier-2 writeback helpers each take a FULL journal copy (<db>.bak-*) with no retention (grep scripts/ops). This lane's two backfill applies alone added ~4.2 GB at 07:22Z/07:26Z. PREVENTION: (1) prune-db-backups action (default retain 7 d, keep newest 2) run after merge; (2) follow-up build: one shared backup helper with retention used by every backup-taking script, refusing to back up when free space < 2x DB size; (3) the signals table holds 4.18M rows, the dominant share of the 2.09 GB, and has no retention, so it needs a retention decision (Tier 2/3).
